newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel slightly weaker, barges tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel slightly weaker, barges tight.

text.p: NWE jet fuel was slightly weaker on Friday on underlying IPE futures, although premiums were fairly steady, traders said.
On the barge market, 2,000 tonnes was done at Oct IPE +$27.75 fob ARA for second half September delivery. Traders said supply remained tight.
"There are very few offers at the moment," one trader said.
On the cif cargo market, premiums were fairly steady at Oct IPE +$35/+$36. The last cargo reported sold was into Copenhagen at Oct IPE +$36.25. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7714
